scope: current deterministic six-stage affiliation sequence, terminal completion, visible labels, command gates, and replay-aligned history

decision_stages.label: Assess partner
decision_stages.uncertainty: The report is bounded and noisy; it is not a true partner forecast.

decision_stages.label: Choose posture
decision_stages.uncertainty: Independence, deferral, and pursuit preserve different outside options.

decision_stages.label: Negotiate commitments
decision_stages.uncertainty: Partner fit and stakeholder responses remain uncertain after commitment.

decision_stages.label: Submit review
decision_stages.uncertainty: Review may approve, condition, delay, or reject the proposal.

decision_stages.label: Resolve review
decision_stages.uncertainty: Review timing and response remain outside Riverside authority.

decision_stages.label: Integrate or decline
decision_stages.uncertainty: Integration creates obligations and drag; decline preserves a different path.

terminal.label: Affiliation complete
terminal.uncertainty: The committed history is available for review; no further affiliation command is available.

sequence.advancement: Each valid host command creates one immutable transition, advances to the recorded successor, and appends aligned history/replay evidence.
sequence.written_equivalent: Stage label, process status, command/result, source, status, effects, uncertainty, and committed history remain available without visual decoration.

presentation_surface.host_boundary: The host owns stage validation, stochastic input resolution, transition, state hash, and replay; the presentation surface is read-only for those results.
presentation_surface.history_boundary: Campaign coverage returns committed history and replay transition metadata; the sequence record does not add persistence or a new replay route.
presentation_surface.live_gui_boundary: The current live GUI launcher supports competitive-regional-v1 only; no browser-native regional-affiliation sequence route is claimed.
presentation_surface.shared_sequence_boundary: The existing browser resolution sequence is competitive-first-month only and is not promoted as affiliation coverage.
presentation_surface.audio_boundary: Existing optional visible-only affiliation audio may accompany supported text/events; it does not make the sequence complete or imply a future outcome.

open_work: stage-specific visual/audio treatment and human quality/accessibility review
full replay/debrief presentation, persistence, instructor views, and educational review
limits: This record covers current deterministic host stage transitions; it does not complete the full affiliation campaign visualization.
Resolved stochastic inputs, private rationale, hidden thresholds, legal validity, causal certainty, and future partner/integration outcomes remain outside the actor-visible sequence.
No browser animation, route, runtime field, persistence, screenshot, instructor view, map, facility, portrait, audio file, registry entry, or authority path is created or promoted.
No human visual, audio, accessibility, educational, legal, policy-validity, or public-release claim is made.
